db-trap-bar-deadlift.caption: Trap (hex) bar deadlift: standing inside the bar, hinge and stand to lockout.

db-backward-medicine-ball-throw.caption: Backward overhead medicine ball throw: ball lowered between the legs in a squat, then thrown back over the head.

bench.caption: Flat barbell bench press, overhand grip, bar to mid-chest and back to lockout.

db-bent-over-barbell-row.caption: Bent-over barbell row, overhand grip, hinge to about 45 degrees, bar to the lower ribs.

db-knee-tuck-jump.caption: Tuck jump: quarter squat, explosive vertical jump, knees driven toward the chest, soft landing.

db-barbell-deadlift.caption: Conventional barbell deadlift, shoulder-width stance, double-overhand grip, to standing lockout.

legpress.caption: 45-degree plate-loaded leg press: feet on the platform, pressing the sled away and back.

db-barbell-incline-bench-press-medium-gr.caption: Incline barbell bench press, medium overhand grip, bar to upper chest and back to lockout.

curl.caption: Standing two-arm dumbbell biceps curl, both arms together, no swinging.

shoulder.caption: Seated two-arm dumbbell shoulder press on a chair, from shoulder height to overhead lockout.

db-superman.caption: Superman: face down, arms reaching forward, arms, chest and legs lifted off the floor together, then lowered.

forma-machine-seated-back-extension.caption: Seated back extension machine: lap belt on, arms crossed, torso extended back against the pad.

db-machine-bench-press.caption: Seated chest press machine: handles at chest height, pressed forward and returned slowly.

db-seated-leg-curl.caption: Seated leg curl machine: thigh pad down, ankles over the lower pad, heels curled down and back.

db-leg-extensions.caption: Seated leg extension machine: shins under the pad, legs straightened and lowered under control.

db-machine-shoulder-military-press.caption: Seated shoulder press machine: handles at shoulder height, pressed overhead and lowered.

wger-af11a7c1-876c-455b-b59a-d8456a99d6e.caption: Seated machine row with a chest pad and neutral-grip handles, pulling the elbows back.

db-pullups.caption: Pull-up with an overhand shoulder-width grip, chin over the bar, full hang between reps.

db-standing-military-press.caption: Standing barbell overhead press from the front rack to lockout, no leg drive, filmed from behind.

squat.caption: High-bar barbell back squat in a rack to about parallel.

db-double-kettlebell-push-press.caption: Two-kettlebell push press: kettlebells racked at the chest, a short knee dip, then leg drive to overhead lockout.

db-calf-press-on-the-leg-press-machine.caption: Calf press on the 45-degree leg press: balls of the feet on the platform edge, pushing the sled with the ankles only.
